_about.eff: Hand-written efficacy lines where rules cannot judge: approved drugs whose text only has sales (pivotal result shown instead), text about the wrong program, related-asset data, failed trials whose subgroup matters. Pivotal figures are from the published registrational trials. caveat = text moved to the Thesis column.
_about.verified: Pivotal figures checked against publications/FDA documents on 2026-11-23, except RYTM, NVAX and HALO/LQDA (generic statements), and lines copied from our own source text.

TENX.eff: Ph3 LEVEL (PH-HFpEF, n=241) missed primary (6MWD +3.5m vs placebo, p=0.63) and KCCQ-TSS key secondary. Prespecified subgroup with baseline 6MWD <333m (n=119): +26.3m at W12 (nominal p=0.011).
TENX.caveat: Subgroup is hypothesis-generating; FDA has not endorsed an enriched LEVEL-2.

EXEL.eff: Ph3 STELLAR-303 (refractory mCRC): ITT mOS 10.9 vs 9.4 mo regorafenib (HR 0.80, met).

LXRX.eff: INPEFA (sotagliflozin) approved for HF: Ph3 SOLOIST-WHF cut CV death + HF events 33% (HR 0.67); Ph3 SCORED (T2D + CKD) HR 0.74. Zynquista approved in T1D.

PBYI.eff: NERLYNX approved in early and metastatic HER2+ BC: Ph3 ExteNET 5-yr iDFS 90.2% vs 87.7% pbo (HR 0.73); Ph3 NALA (mBC) PFS HR 0.76 vs lapatinib.

BDTX.eff: Ph2 1L EGFR non-classical NSCLC (n=43): ORR 60%, mPFS 15.0 mo; untreated brain mets CNS-ORR 86% (n=7).

CTNM.eff: No efficacy data yet; Ph2 PROPEL-IPF ongoing (FVC vs placebo at W26). LPA1 is validated in IPF (BMS admilparant), but PIPE-791 is behind; its pain crossover showed no clear significance.

SANA.eff: Related asset, not the lead (SC451 is preclinical): investigator-sponsored UP421 (HIP-modified donor islets, no immunosuppression) kept surviving and producing insulin through 14 mo.

ERAS.eff: Ph1 AURORAS-1, unconfirmed ORR: 2L+ NSCLC 62% (n=37); 2L+ KRAS G12X PDAC 57% (4/7).
ERAS.caveat: All responses unconfirmed; confirmed ORR, PFS and grade 3+ rash/GI rates not disclosed. Not comparable to RASolute-302 (randomized Ph3, OS HR 0.40).

ANAB.eff: Royalty on partner GSK's Jemperli in endometrial cancer: Ph3 RUBY Part 1 dMMR PFS HR 0.28; overall OS HR 0.69 vs chemo alone.

CRVS.eff: Lead (r/r PTCL): registrational Ph3 ongoing; no new PTCL efficacy in our file. Secondary AD program: Ph1 (n=72) mean EASI −72% vs −40% placebo.

ALEC.eff: No efficacy data yet for lead AL137 (Alzheimer's). Prior progranulin programs failed: latozinemab missed Ph3 INFRONT-3 in FTD-GRN.

SION.eff: No efficacy data yet for lead SION-451 + SION-2222. Earlier SION-719 added to Trikafta failed Ph2a (sweat chloride −1.0 mmol/L vs placebo, p=0.7).

PTCT.eff: Ph3 MOVE-FA (vatiquinone, FA) missed primary (mFARS pbo-corrected 1.6, p=0.14); FDA CRL. Votoplam (HD) Ph2 PIVOT-HD: 52% cUHDRS slowing vs natural history.

IMVT.eff: Lead Graves' data pending. IMVT-1402 in difficult-to-treat RA: 600 mg met primary (ACR20 W28 92.5% vs 75.6% placebo); 300 mg no difference.

MPLT.eff: Ph2 ZEPHYR (SCZ, n=307): 210/3 mg BID met primary (PANSS total vs placebo); effect size in the card.

KLRA.eff: No efficacy data yet for Kailera's own KAI-7535. Partner Hengrui's HRS-7535 Ph3s in China (HARBOR-1/OUTSTAND-2): 10.9-11.1% weight loss at W44/50, no liver signal.

KURA.eff: KOMZIFTI (ziftomenib) approved in r/r NPM1m AML: Ph2 KOMET-001 CR/CRh 22% (n=92; met vs 12% historical), 61% MRD-negative.

OMER.eff: YARTEMLEA (narsoplimab) approved for HSCT-TA-TMA: pivotal single-arm study TMA response 61% (n=28).

FENC.eff: PEDMARK approved to prevent cisplatin hearing loss in children: Ph3 SIOPEL-6 hearing loss 33% vs 63% cisplatin alone.

MIST.eff: CARDAMYST (etripamil) approved for PSVT: Ph3 RAPID conversion to sinus rhythm within 30 min 64% vs 31% placebo.

BBIO.eff: Attruby (acoramidis) approved for ATTR-CM: Ph3 ATTRibute-CM win ratio 1.8; all-cause death + first CV hospitalization HR 0.65; CV hospitalizations halved.

KRYS.eff: VYJUVEK approved for DEB wounds: Ph3 GEM-3 complete wound healing at 6 mo 67% vs 22% placebo.

ABEO.eff: ZEVASKYN approved for RDEB wounds: Ph3 VIITAL ≥50% wound healing at W24 81% vs 16% control.

TARS.eff: XDEMVY approved for Demodex blepharitis: Ph3 Saturn-2 collarette cure 56% vs 13% vehicle.

PHAT.eff: VOQUEZNA approved in erosive GERD: Ph3 PHALCON-EE healing by W8 92.9% vs 84.6% lansoprazole.

KNSA.eff: ARCALYST approved in recurrent pericarditis: Ph3 RHAPSODY recurrence risk cut 96% vs placebo (HR 0.04).

ASND.eff: YORVIPATH approved in hypoparathyroidism: Ph3 PaTHway responders 79% vs 5% placebo.

CRMD.eff: DefenCath approved to prevent catheter infections in hemodialysis: Ph3 LOCK-IT-100 cut CRBSI 71% vs heparin.

AGIO.eff: Ph3 RISE UP (mitapivat, SCD): Hb response 40.6% vs 2.9% placebo (met); annualized pain-crisis reduction not significant.

IBRX.eff: ANKTIVA + BCG approved in BCG-unresponsive NMIBC CIS: Ph2/3 QUILT-3.032 CR 62%. Ph3 QUILT-2.005 (BCG-naive, n=366) met primary Nov 2026.

IMCR.eff: KIMMTRAK approved in HLA-A*02:01+ met. uveal melanoma: Ph3 1-yr OS 73% vs 59% investigator's choice (HR 0.51).

BCRX.eff: ORLADEYO approved for HAE prophylaxis: Ph3 APeX-2 cut attack rate 44% vs placebo (150 mg).

VRDN.eff: Ph3 THRIVE (veligrotug, TED): proptosis responders 70% vs 5% placebo.

TVTX.eff: FILSPARI approved in IgAN: Ph3 PROTECT proteinuria −49.8% vs −15.1% irbesartan at W36; eGFR slope favoured sparsentan.

BMRN.eff: VOXZOGO approved in achondroplasia: Ph3 annualized growth velocity +1.57 cm/yr vs placebo.

MDGL.eff: Rezdiffra approved in MASH F2-F3: Ph3 MAESTRO-NASH resolution 26-30% vs 10% placebo; fibrosis improvement 24-26% vs 14%.

SRPT.eff: ELEVIDYS: Ph3 EMBARK missed primary (NSAA +0.65 pts vs placebo, p=0.24); key secondaries favoured treatment. Label now limited to ambulatory pts.

NVAX.eff: Nuvaxovid: Ph3 PREVENT-19 efficacy 90.4% against symptomatic COVID-19.

SPRY.eff: neffy approved for anaphylaxis on PK/PD comparable to injected epinephrine (no efficacy trial needed).

ARQT.eff: ZORYVE cream approved in PsO: Ph3 DERMIS-1/2 IGA success 42%/38% vs 6%/7% vehicle at W8.

ARDX.eff: IBSRELA approved in IBS-C: Ph3 T3MPO-1 combined responders 27.0% vs 18.7% placebo.

XFOR.eff: XOLREMDI approved in WHIM: Ph3 4WHIM time above ANC threshold 15.0 vs 2.8 h placebo. Lead chronic neutropenia Ph3 4WARD ongoing.

ZVRA.eff: MIPLYFFA approved in NPC: Ph2/3 5-domain NPCCSS −1.40 vs pbo at 12 mo (65% slower annual progression).

SRRK.eff: Ph3 SAPPHIRE (apitegromab, SMA): HFMSE +1.8 pts vs placebo (p=0.019).

RYTM.eff: IMCIVREE approved in genetic obesity: Ph3 ≥10% weight loss in 80% (POMC) and 46% (LEPR) of pts at ~1 yr.

SIGA.eff: TPOXX approved for smallpox under the animal rule; human STOMP trial (mpox) missed primary (lesion resolution).

VCEL.eff: MACI approved for knee cartilage defects: Ph3 SUMMIT KOOS pain 37→83 vs 36→71 and function 15→61 vs 13→49 for microfracture at Y2 (p=0.001).

HALO.eff: Delivery platform: ENHANZE subcutaneous versions approved on PK non-inferiority vs IV partner drugs.

PHAR.eff: Joenja approved in APDS: Ph3 met both co-primaries vs pbo: index lymph-node size −0.25 log10 SPD and naive B cells +37 pts at W12.

NTRB.eff: Abuse-deterrent fentanyl patch; efficacy relies on approved fentanyl. Pivotal human abuse potential study planned.

YARW.eff: No efficacy data yet for YB-101 in Graves'. Context: no new Graves' drug approved in the US since 1950.

TLX.eff: Illuccix/Gozellix approved for PSMA-PET imaging. Lead therapy TLX591 Ph3 ProstACT Global: Part 1 met objectives; no efficacy readout yet.

LQDA.eff: YUTREPIA approved in PAH and PH-ILD via 505(b)(2) on treprostinil's established efficacy; Ph3 INSPIRE showed tolerability on switch.

HUMA.eff: Symvess approved for vascular trauma. Ph3 V012 (dialysis access, women): ATEV 220 vs 129 catheter-free days vs AV fistula.

AVBP.eff: Ph3 FURVENT (1L ex20ins): mPFS 11.0 vs 9.5 mo by BICR (HR 0.75, p=0.0654), missed primary despite confirmed BICR ORR 60% vs 33%.

AVXL.eff: Ph2/3: ADAS-Cog13 −2.03 (36% slowing) ITT (p=0.0079), CDR-SB benefit — but FDA/EMA found the subgroup analyses insufficient; confirmatory trial needed.

COGT.eff: Ph3 SUMMIT (NonAdvSM) met primary: TSS −24.3 vs −15.4 placebo at W24 (p=0.0002), deepening to −32.0 (65% mean improvement) at W48. Also positive: Ph3 PEAK (GIST, + sunitinib) and AdvSM.

PRTA.eff: Ph2b PADOVA (early PD): time to motor progression HR 0.84 (p=0.0657, narrowly missed) with a consistent motor-slowing trend; OLE showed a sustained effect and exploratory MRI (neuromelanin/iron) suggests biological activity. Roche moved to Ph3 PARAISO.

MLYS.eff: Two positive pivotals: Ph3 Launch-HTN placebo-adjusted SBP −9.1 mmHg (W6); Ph2 Advance-HTN −7.9 mmHg (W12), both on background therapy. 374× selective for aldosterone synthase vs cortisol.

SNDX.eff: REVUFORJ approved in r/r KMT2Ar and NPM1m acute leukemia: pivotal AUGMENT-101 CR/CRh ~23% in each cohort. Expansion: SAVE combo (r/r) ORR 88% (CR/CRh 60%); 1L revumenib + chemo CRc ~97%.

VANI.eff: SLIM-1 (open-label, n=10/arm, 4 wks): weight loss 0.79% vs 0.82% Wegovy 0.25 mg; TRAEs 0/10 vs 5/10 (all GI); no SAEs; peak exposure ~16 vs ~2.4 days.

KRSA.eff: No efficacy data yet; Ph1 healthy-volunteer data mid-27. Design: validated anti-amyloid targeting (lecanemab, donanemab) with TfR1 brain shuttling to raise brain exposure, speed plaque clearance and cut ARIA risk.

MGTX.eff: Bota-vec (XLRP) Ph3 LUMEOS (n=95, bilateral dosing): no efficacy numbers disclosed; company says data highlight potential to improve vision.

APMD.eff: Ph3 SynAIRgy (n=646): AHI −55.6% vs −19.1% pbo at W26 (p<0.0001). Ph3 LunAIRo (n=660): AHI −46.8% vs −6.8% pbo at W26 (p<0.001), still significant at W51.

CTY.eff: Ph1 HV: >60% FXI knockdown at lower doses; 85% knockdown 3 wks after single 150 mg SC dose.

ACHV.eff: ORCA-OL 52-wk (n=479): quit rate 25.5% at W9-12 rising to 31.2% at W49-52. Ph3 ORCA-2: W9-12 abstinence 32.6% vs 7.0% pbo.

CUE.eff: CUE-221 Ph2 China CSU (subgroup: 4 mg/kg, high baseline IgE ≥300 IU/mL): 78% complete hives resolution at W12 vs 0% pbo; effect maintained at W28, 12 wks after last dose. ⚠ Subgroup result; overall not reported.

AMRN.eff: VASCEPA (Ph3 REDUCE-IT: MACE −25%, HR 0.75). US share up to 48% from 43% despite generics; partner in-market demand +59% YoY (Europe +69%, China +90% YTD).

NUVB.eff: IBTROZI approved in ROS1+ NSCLC: TRUST-I/II pooled cORR 89.8% TKI-naive (n=157) and 55.8% TKI-pretreated (n=113); TKI-naive mDOR 49.7 mo (TRUST-I, on label Sep 2026).

RCKT.eff: Ph1 (n=7): LAMP2 protein expression in all evaluable pts at M12 (sustained to M60); LV mass index down ≥10% at M12 (sustained to M54); median cTnI −84%, NT-proBNP −57%; LVEF preserved.

ORKA.eff: Ph2a EVERLAST-A (600 mg at W0 + W4 only): PASI100 63.5% vs 4.8% pbo at W16, deepening to PASI100 71%, PASI90 87% at W28, ~6 mo after last dose (supports yearly dosing). Ph2b EVERLAST-B (n=187) W16: PASI100 61% (high dose), PASI90 and IGA 0/1 86%; no pbo responders.

PTGX.eff: Royalty on partner J&J's ICOTYDE (icotrokinra), approved in PsO Mar 2026: Ph3 ICONIC-LEAD IGA 0/1 65% vs 8% pbo, PASI90 50% vs 4% at W16.

ZYME.eff: Royalty on partner Jazz's Ziihera (approved 1L GEA Aug 2026, + 2L BTC): Ph3 HERIZON-GEA-01 final OS HR 0.65 for Ziihera + tislelizumab + chemo (0.72 at interim).

INVA.eff: Royalties on partner GSK's BREO/ANORO inhalers. Own XACDURO approved for Acinetobacter: Ph3 ATTACK 28-day mortality 19% vs 32% colistin (non-inferior).

TGTX.eff: BRIUMVI approved in relapsing MS: Ph3 ULTIMATE I/II annualized relapse rate 0.08 vs 0.19 and 0.09 vs 0.18 teriflunomide. Ph1 SubQ: bioavailability >60% vs IV, supporting Q3M.
